articles.summary: CARLSBAD, Calif., Feb. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Exagen Inc. (Nasdaq: XGN), a leading provider of innovative autoimmune testing, will release financial results for the quarter ended December 31, 2025, before the market opens on Tuesday, March 10, 2026.
articles.title: Exagen Inc. to Announce Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results on March 10, 2026
